name: Mansam Floral Collection
body:
Discover three floral fragrances from Mansam.
Swipe to find your favourite and tap Shop Now.
required_before_launch: Create and obtain Meta approval for the marketing carousel template; this draft is not an approved template.
Receive customer CSV and verify marketing consent and suppression list.
Confirm sending date, time, frequency and recipient count.
Implement and deploy the authenticated campaign queue and scheduler with duplicate protection and opt-out handling.
Review the final campaign and applicable Meta charges with the owner before activation.
